test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.**

The teacher started a new game to keep the class engaged.

options.text: A new game to keep the class engaged was being started by the teacher.
A new game was started by the teacher to keep the class engaged.
A new game to keep the teacher engaged is started by the class.
A new game to keep the class engaged has been started by the teacher.

solution:
The correct answer is '**A new game was started by the teacher to keep the class engaged.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and in the simple past tense and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The simple past tense in the active voice has the following form: Subject + V2+ object + rest of the sentence__
 
• The simple past tense in the passive voice has the following form: __Object+ was/were + V3+ by + subject + rest of the sentence__
 __
 
• Active: *Rohit called his friends.*
 
• Passive: *His friends were called by Rohit.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct passive Voice:__ *A new game was started by the teacher to keep the class engaged.*
